LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions, part of Strand 13 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are? 2. How do we show the position of people and things?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify prepositions in samples of oral or written texts,

2. play grade-appropriate preposition games online or offline,

3. construct sentences using prepositions,

4. complete gaps in sentences, as well as match prepositions with pictures,

5. complete substitution exercises using prepositions,

6. watch videos, visit web pages and other online resources and pick out prepositions collaboratively,

7. create and display preposition charts. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify prepositions in samples of oral or written texts,
2. play grade-appropriate preposition games online or offline,
3. construct sentences using prepositions,
4. complete gaps in sentences, as well as match prepositions with pictures,
5. complete substitution exercises using prepositions,
6. watch videos, visit web pages and other online resources and pick out prepositions collaboratively,
7. create and display preposition charts. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: The learner develops confidence and self-esteem when using prepositions correctly.

• Digital Literacy: The learner interacts with technology through watching videos and television programmes and seeing

how people use prepositions in conversation.

• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner creates and displays charts featuring prepositions in the classroom.

Values:
• Love: It is achieved as the learner respects others’ work as created and displayed on preposition charts.

• Responsibility: The learner offers leadership and guidance to others while preparing to play appropriate preposition

online and offline games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Financial Literacy: This is realised when the learner interacts with materials about money as they watch videos about

how people use money in their daily lives.

• Citizenship: This is nurtured as the learner learns about money and the importance of paying taxes to foster patriotism.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can link the content taught here to Social Studies where as a concept patriotism is promoted through sensitising

learners about money and payment of tax.
